run: Harbourline Studio Ltd, September 2026 month-end supplier payment run
revision: 3: principal answers to E1 to E4 applied; nothing open
latest_change: R06 hold changed back to pay: E4 answered, the principal approved the full GBP 5400.00 in this run.
changes_since_first_handoff: R06 stays pay, now approved by the principal at GBP 5400.00 (E4). The first answer (E1) was GBP 5100.00 net of CN-012; CN-012 was already refunded (bank feed 2026-09-10), so nothing is offset.
R05 stays hold: the principal answered HOLD; it goes in the FX run on 7 October.
R11 hold changed to exclude: the principal answered REJECT; details not updated.
how_to_read: One entry per document, R01 to R12, numbered as in work/invoices.json. Amounts are strings with two decimals, no separators.
decision is pay, hold or exclude. amount_to_pay is the figure to schedule: 0.00 for hold and exclude. A hold shows what it would pay in amount_if_released.
principal_approval_needed true means the principal decides; principal_answer records what they said. Do not schedule an item that is waiting on an open escalation.
Bank details come from data/supplier_bank.json only. Every payment goes to the details on file.
exclude_code uses the codes in data/schema_payment_run.md.

checks.po_match: Each invoice matched to its PO by number and supplier. PO-1039 GBP 4500.00 net, PO-1041 GBP 1240.00 net, PO-1044 GBP 300.00 net, PO-1046 USD 960.00 net. PO-1047 (Evergreen, GBP 180.00 net) has no invoice.
checks.bank_feed: Feed period 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-29; closing balance 46440.98 ties to the opening balance and transactions. Supplier lines: 2026-09-03 DR 142.80 EVERGREEN OFFICE EO-55120 (agrees with statement R10); 2026-09-10 CR 300.00 MARLOW DESIGN CN-012 REFUND (R04); 2026-09-18 DR 1488.00 NORTHFIELD PRINT INV-000482 (R01). Nothing paid for INV-000488, INV-000491, MD-2026-057 or 7731.
checks.supplier_master: Sender domains of R01 to R10 and R12 match the master. R11 does not: northfield-print.co against northfield-print.co.uk on file. Kestrel Cloud Inc is a USD supplier with a USD account on file; the other three are GBP.

run_notes: Variance accepted (policy 4): INV-000491 (R08), Northfield Print Ltd, PO-1044. Invoice GBP 315.50 net against PO GBP 300.00 net, +15.50 net, within the 50.00 tolerance. Paid at the invoice gross GBP 378.60. Reason: the corrected invoice prices letterheads at 82.75 per thousand (2,000 sheets, 165.50) plus business cards 150.00; the PO gives one total of 300.00 net with no line split.
No other variance: MD-2026-057 GBP 4500.00 net equals PO-1039; Kestrel 7731 USD 960.00 net equals PO-1046; INV-000482 GBP 1240.00 net equals PO-1041 (already paid).
INV-000482 (R01) already paid on 2026-09-18, GBP 1488.00, per the bank feed. Excluded (policy 6).
CN-012 (R04), GBP 300.00 gross, was refunded by Marlow on 2026-09-10 per the bank feed. Policy 7: nothing is offset against MD-2026-057.

MD-2026-057 (R06): the principal first approved GBP 5100.00 net of CN-012 (E1). That would have offset a credit Marlow already refunded and left Marlow 300.00 short, so E4 asked for confirmation. The principal confirmed the refund is in the bank feed and approved the full GBP 5400.00 in this run. Nothing is offset (policy 7).
INV-000488 voided by the supplier on 2026-09-08; INV-000491 first issue superseded by the corrected version; MD-2026-057 resend is a duplicate. Each number is paid at most once (policy 5).

Bank details (policy 8): the principal answered E3 with REJECT. The Northfield change request (R11) is refused, the details are not updated, and Northfield is paid to the details on file. The .co email is treated as suspected fraud. The principal will call Northfield on the number on file. The supplier master was not edited.
Kestrel 7731 (R05): the principal answered E2 with HOLD. It is not paid in this run, it goes in the FX run on 7 October, and it stays on the run as HOLD.
PO-1047 (Evergreen, GBP 180.00 net) is open with no invoice received by 30 September; nothing to pay. The Evergreen statement shows a nil balance.
Payment date is the second working day of October 2026, Friday 2 October (policy 1).
